verification.scope: Disposable loopback PostgreSQL/Redis; actual authenticated stop endpoint with zero Redis subscribers

corrected_behavior: HTTP 503 when publisher missing or result is not exactly True
Publication exception or deadline returns unconfirmed, with no automatic resend
RUNNING status, finished_at, result and device lock remain intact
Genuine completion after rejected stop remains accepted
Caller cancellation propagates and does not retry or release the running task
residual_limits: A successful Redis publish is still not physical stop confirmation
Durable cancellation intent/reconciliation and pipeline child cancellation remain open
QUEUED/ASSIGNED cancellation and other stop writers are not changed
A timed-out publication may have been delivered; check actual state before retrying
No backend/APK deployment or native stop acceptance in this change
